elements.title: Liceu bombing (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that six innocent people were executed for the Liceu bombing (pictured), despite Santiago Salvador confessing that he was the sole perpetrator?

elements.title: Pixel Piracy (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Pixel Piracy's developers released a free torrent of their game?

elements.title: Good Riddance (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Gracie Abrams wrote Good Riddance about her breakup from her former collaborator and boyfriend, Blake Slatkin?

elements.title: Wu Zhong (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Wu Zhong was recognized as the youngest general in the Chinese People's Liberation Army after the first holder was stripped of the title following his emigration to the Soviet Union?

elements.title: Lonely Orchid (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the 1926 film Lonely Orchid was adapted from a British novel via a Chinese translation of a Japanese translation?

elements.title: Frederick W. Hinitt (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that two different colleges experienced fires while Frederick W. Hinitt was their president?

elements.title: occupied a factory and took hostages (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that South Korean sources reported in January 2024 that several thousand North Korean migrant workers occupied a factory and took hostages?

elements.title: Ethel Lote (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that World War II nurse Ethel Lote practised yoga and tai chi until she was 95?

elements.title: Prius Missile (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that "Prius Missile" is internet slang for traffic accidents involving older drivers in Japan?
